v01: Tableau Public has no publishing API.
v02: And no official library can build workbooks from scratch.
v03: Tableau Public Authoring MCP builds and publishes them anyway.
v05: A dry run checks every field against the data, so a typo fails with the right names.
v06: The compiler writes the workbook, and turns each CSV into the Hyper extract Tableau Public requires.
v07: Then it opens the file in the real Tableau Public app, and photographs it.
v08: Five of Tableau's load rules only showed up that way.
v09: Every screenshot here is a generated workbook, untouched in Tableau.
v10: Publishing drives Tableau's own save flow, in your signed-in session.
v11: It never reads credentials, and won't replace a live workbook unless told to.
v12: 507 tests pass without Tableau. 15 more drive the real app.
v14: Declarative specs, compiled into Tableau workbooks.
